backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing partner registration, property management, lead tracking, and commission systems with role-based access control using Internet Identity authentication.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implementation of partner registration, property dashboard, lead management, commission tracking, and Internet Identity authentication with high confidence test coverage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON summary of all frontend files describing components for authentication, property listings, lead management, commission tracking, and UI styling with real estate theme.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes using earth-toned real estate palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Real Estate Channel Partner App with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for login, dashboard, leads, and commissions pages, wrapped in theme provider and authentication guards.
frontend/src/components/AddLeadForm.tsx: Form component for adding new customer leads with validation and toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to login and displays loading state during initialization.
frontend/src/components/CommissionSummar: Dashboard cards displaying total earned, pending commissions, and payment count with color-coded icons and currency formatting.
Displays a table of commission records with ID, amount, status badges, and payment dates, including loading states and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation (Dashboard, Leads, Commissions), login button, and footer with branding and attribution.
frontend/src/components/LeadCard.tsx: Card component displaying individual lead information with customer name, status badge, and color-coded status indicators.
frontend/src/components/LeadList.tsx: Manages and displays a grid of lead cards with an "Add New Lead" button that toggles the AddLeadForm component.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to complete their partner profile with name, company, contact, and license information.
frontend/src/components/PropertyCard.tsx: Card component displaying property details including image, location, price, type, and availability status with conditional image selection.
frontend/src/components/PropertyList.tsx: Displays a filterable grid of property cards with search by location and filters for property type and status.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors while invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, properties, leads, and commissions data from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earth-toned color scheme for light and dark modes suitable for real estate branding.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/CommissionsPage.tsx: Page component displaying commission tracking with summary statistics and a detailed commission table using data from useGetCommissions hook.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page with hero banner, property statistics cards (available, residential, commercial counts), and a property list component.
frontend/src/pages/LeadsPage.tsx: Lead management page showing total, new, in-progress, and closed lead counts with a detailed lead list component.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with branding, feature highlights, and Internet Identity login button that redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, custom shadows, Inter font family, and accordion animations with typography and container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a real estate channel partner management application with 7 implemented features including partner registration, property listings, lead management, commission tracking, Internet Identity authentication, and professional UI design.
